user.title: Add a PC
user.description: On the PC, enable the local API in config.yaml (run `python -m pclink api-token` for a ready-made block) and restart the service.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the PC.
data_description.tls: Switch on when the PC serves HTTPS (api.tls_cert and api.tls_key in its config.yaml).
data_description.fingerprint: SHA-256 fingerprint of the PC's certificate, as `pclink make-cert` prints it. Needed for a self-signed certificate; only that certificate is then accepted.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Add {name}
zeroconf_confirm.description: {name} was found at {host}. Connection: {security}. Anything on the network can announce itself, so compare this with what setup-api printed on the PC before you enter its API token (api.token in config.yaml on the PC).

reauth_confirm.title: New token for {name}
reauth_confirm.description: The PC rejected the stored token. Enter the current api.token from its config.yaml.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure {name}
reconfigure.description: Change the address, port or token of this PC. Its connection now: {security}.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the PC.
data_description.tls: Switch on when the PC serves HTTPS (api.tls_cert and api.tls_key in its config.yaml).
data_description.fingerprint: SHA-256 fingerprint of the PC's certificate, as `pclink make-cert` prints it. Needed for a self-signed certificate; only that certificate is then accepted.
data_description.token: Leave empty to keep the current token - only possible for the current address, or with the certificate fingerprint left as it is.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Check the address, that api.enabled is true, api.host is 0.0.0.0 and the Windows firewall allows the port.
error.invalid_auth: The token was rejected, or it is the read-only token.
error.invalid_host: That is not a host name or an address.
error.invalid_fingerprint: A SHA-256 fingerprint has 64 hexadecimal digits.
error.tls_error: The PC's certificate was not accepted. Check the fingerprint, and that HTTPS is switched on here exactly when the PC serves it.
error.outdated: The PC Link service on that PC is too old for this integration; update it.
error.wrong_device: That address belongs to a different PC.
error.token_required: Enter the API token: it is only kept for the address the PC has now, or when the PC has to show the pinned certificate.
error.too_many_attempts: The PC refuses this address for a while after too many wrong tokens. Wait a few minutes and try again.
error.busy: The PC has no connection free right now. Try again in a few seconds.

abort.no_id: The discovered service did not identify itself.
abort.wrong_device: The PC at that address is not the one that was discovered.
